scope: Site contributor's documented interpretation, crosschecked with primary implementation; not an official Korean stroke standard.

observedDefinitions.line2: Horizontal line endpoint connects to another stroke.
observedDefinitions.line32: Vertical line endpoint connects to the interior of another stroke.

engine.finding: Type32 adjusts the terminal cap polygon around the same straight centerline. Unlike tail4/14, these connection cases add no new directional stroke or hook.

implementation: Opt-in allowConnectionLines only; defaults unchanged. Raw fields are retained. Reject non-axis-aligned connection forms, hooks, corners, other heads/tails and component stretch. Entire glyph still needs separate domestic visual approval.
